messages.subject: Odd behavior under clang++
parts:
I think I'm finally seeing what Ben has been seeing. I thought the
tests were passing under both clang++ and g++, but I guess I was
mistaken.

test/agrad/distributions/univariate/continuous/beta is failing under clang++

I'll try to get to the bottom of this.


Daniel

messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] Odd behavior under clang++
parts:
I think the problem is more likely to be a difference of behavior across OS because I am getting a couple of MetaTraits test failures under both clang++ and g++-4.7 (and no test failures with the beta or student-t distributions). But g++-4.7 spews a lot of warnings about maybe-uninitialized variables in the tests, and it wouldn't be surprising if different OS have different behavior with uninitialized variables.

Ben
